defs.def: a variety of things of a particular type 一系列

ex.s: The 21st century has created a whole range of new types of professionals that we have never had before — or if not quite new, at least newly repackaged.
ex.t: 21世纪创造了一系列我们以前从未有过的新类型专业人士——或者即使不算全新，至少也是被重新包装过的。

ex.s: Explorers Camp organizes engaging arts, history and science-related activities in every! class, and focuses on a range of topics that emphasize active learning, exploration and, most of all, fun!
ex.t: 探索者营在每一节课上都组织引人入胜的与艺术、历史、科学相关的活动，并聚焦于一系列强调主动学习、探索，尤其是乐趣的主题！

ex.s: Quality teaching is one of the most important predictors of a wide range of college outcomes.
ex.t: 优质教学是广泛大学成果最重要的预测因素之一。

ex.s: Its field staff in Africa oversee a range of grassroots conservation projects, all of them aimed at addressing the key threats facing gorillas today.
ex.t: 其驻非洲的实地工作人员监管一系列基层保护项目，所有这些项目都旨在应对当今大猩猩面临的主要威胁。

ex.s: Who knows, perhaps some of the more forward-looking   65   (one) may yet come out with a whole range of “just for you” pack sizes with special offers as well.
ex.t: 他们弄清楚自己擅长什么。___36___刺猬理念对公司来说完全适用。

defs.def: the limits between which sth varies （变动或浮动的）范围，界限，区域

ex.s: By the early 1970s, after centuries of cruel and continuous hunting by settlers, 600 to 800 grizzlies remained on a mere 2 percent of their former range in the Northern Rockies.
ex.t: 到20世纪70年代初，在定居者几个世纪残酷而持续的捕猎之后，在北部落基山脉，仅剩600到800只灰熊栖息在它们昔日活动范围的区区2%的土地上。

ex.s: B The expansion of bears’ range.
ex.t: B 熊类活动范围的扩大。

ex.s: narrow his range of knowledge
ex.t: 缩小知识范围

ex.s: What is the age range required by Stewardship Youth Ranger Program?
ex.t: 资源管理员青年护林员项目要求的年龄范围是多少？

ex.s: It is difficult to figure out a global population of polar bears as much of the range has been    62   (poor) studied; however, biologists calculate that there are about 20,000-25,000 polar bears worldwide.
ex.t: 很难弄清北极熊的全球数量，因为其大部分活动范围___62___（poor）被研究；不过，生物学家估算全球约有20,000至25,000只北极熊。

ex.s: The vast range in altitude results in a great variation in climatic conditions.
ex.t: 巨大的海拔范围导致了气候条件的极大差异。

ex.s: “Grizzly bears are re-occupying large areas of their former range,” says bear biologist Chris Servheen.
ex.t: “灰熊正在重新占据它们昔日活动范围的大片区域，”熊类生物学家克里斯·瑟夫希恩说。

ex.s: Color choices in this range are a step up from the small ones in two major ways
ex.t: 这一范围的色彩选择在小面积选择基础上有两个主要提升

ex.s: Each volume in the set explores____41____wide range of material, explains the basic concepts of major applications of digital systems, ____42____discusses the influences they have on everyday life.
ex.t: 丛书的每一卷都探讨了____41____广泛的材料，解释了数字系统主要应用的基本概念，____42____并讨论了它们对日常生活的影响。

ex.s: The GPNP is intended to provide stronger protection for all the species ____65____ live within the Giant Panda Range and significantly improve the health of the ecosystem in the area.
ex.t: 全球方案计划旨在为生活在大熊猫范围内的____65____所有物种提供更有力的保护,并显著改善该地区的生态系统健康。

ex.s: In any given office, employees can range from age 22 to 70 and beyond, and finding common ground in communication style can be a challenge. ___38___.
ex.t: 在任何一家办公室里，员工年龄可能从22岁到70岁甚至更大，要在沟通风格上找到共同点可能很难。___38___。

ex.s: The advantage that foxes have is that they are more likely to seek out new information from a broader range of sources, and are comfortable with uncertainty and new information. ___38___ They try to include it in their viewpoint rather than to exclude it from their thinking.
ex.t: 狐狸的优势在于，它们更可能从更广泛的来源寻找新信息，并且能从容面对不确定性和新信息。___38___ 它们试图将其纳入自己的观点，而不是将其排除在思维之外。

defs.def: a set of products of a particular type 类；种

ex.s: Over the last seven years, most states have banned texting by drivers, and public service campaigns have tried a wide range of methods to persuade people to put down their phones when they are behind the wheel.
ex.t: 过去七年里，大多数州已禁止司机发短信，公益宣传用了多种方法说服人们开车时放下手机。

defs.def: the distance over which sth can be seen or heard 视觉（或听觉）范围

ex.s: As grizzly bears expand their range into places where they haven’t been seen in a century or more, they’re increasingly being sighted by humans.
ex.t: 随着灰熊的活动范围扩展到它们一个多世纪未见的地方，它们越来越多地被人类看到。

defs.def: the distance over which a gun or other weapon can hit things 射程；射击距离
the distance that a vehicle will travel before it needs more fuel （车辆）加一次油可行的路程
a line or group of mountains or hills 山脉

ex.s: With an average elevation of about 4,000 to 5,000 metres, the Plateau is surrounded by massive mountain ranges.
ex.t: 平均海拔约4,000至5,000米，高原被巨大的山脉环绕。

defs.def: an area of land where people can practise shooting or where bombs, etc. can be tested 靶场；射击场；炸弹试验场
a large piece of equipment that can burn various fuels and is kept hot all the time, used for cooking, especially in the past （尤指旧时的）炉灶
把肉放在炉灶上用文火炖着。
a large open area for keeping cows, etc. 牧场；乳牛场
to vary between two particular amounts, sizes, etc., including others between them （在一定的范围内）变化，变动

ex.s: We house a broad range of experts united by the common goal of creating the best language learning tools possible.
ex.t: 我们汇聚了众多专家，他们因创造尽可能好的语言学习工具这一共同目标而团结在一起。

defs.def: to include a variety of different things in addition to those mentioned 包括（从 … 到 … ）之间的各类事物

ex.s: With a different theme each year, the day Is observed with a wide range of events that are organised at local, national and international levels.
ex.t: 每年有不同的主题，这一天以地方、国家和国际层面组织的各种活动来纪念。

ex.s: While they are rare north of 88°,there is evidence   61   they range all the way across the Arctic, and as far south as James Bay in Canada.
ex.t: 虽然它们在88°以北很少见，但有证据____61__它们分布横贯整个北极，最南到加拿大的詹姆斯湾。

ex.s: The colours of the flowers range from bright yellows to brownish yellows, showing that the flowers are at different stages of life.
ex.t: 花的颜色从亮黄色到棕黄色不等，显示出花朵处于生命的不同阶段。

ex.s: My classmates ranged from those kids with pale skin and large blue eyes to those with rich brown skin and dark hair.
ex.t: 我的同学从皮肤苍白、蓝眼睛的孩子到深棕色皮肤、黑头发的孩子都有。

ex.s: Campers enjoy a staff-to-child ratio ranging from 1:4 to 1:7 depending on the age group.
ex.t: 营员享受的员工与儿童比例在1:4到1:7之间，取决于年龄组。

ex.s: Generalists, on the other hand, know a lot about a wide range of subjects and view the whole with all its connections.
ex.t: 另一方面，通才对广泛的学科知之甚多，并能带着所有联系去看待整体。

defs.def: to arrange people or things in a particular position or order （按一定位置或顺序）排列，排序
to move around an area 徘徊；漫步；四处移动
